// CASE ts_awaited_callee_receiver expect=fire
export async function mapLimit<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	pool: () => Promise<{ send(item: T): Promise<void> }>,
): Promise<void> {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await (await pool()).send(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE ts_awaited_callee_index expect=fire
export async function mapLimit2<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	clients: { send(item: T): Promise<void> }[],
): Promise<void> {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await clients[await pickSlot()].send(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE ts_results_awaited_callee expect=fire
export async function mapLimit3<T, R>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	pool: () => Promise<{ run(item: T): Promise<R> }>,
): Promise<R[]> {
	const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await (await pool()).run(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_nullish_fallback expect=fire
export async function mapLimit4<T, R>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	op: (item: T) => Promise<R | undefined>,
	fallback: (item: T) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
	const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] =
					(await op(items[index])) ?? (await fallback(items[index]));
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

// CASE ts_call_chain_then expect=fire
export async function mapLimit5<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	op: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await op(items[index]).then(() => audit(index));
			}
		}),
	);
}

// CASE ts_iife_callee expect=fire
export async function mapLimit6<T>(items: T[], width: number): Promise<void> {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await (async (item: T) => {
					await save(item);
					await audit(item);
				})(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}
